## What changed

Describe the problem and the behavior this pull request changes.

## Evidence

Include tests, a sanitized before/after report, or benchmark output. For heuristic changes, explain why the signal should move and add a focused fixture.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm run check`.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I updated documentation and examples when the public interface changed.
- [ ] I rebuilt `dist/` and confirmed `git diff --exit-code -- dist` succeeds after rebuilding.
- [ ] I did not include private repository content, credentials, or personal paths in fixtures or generated assets.
- [ ] I added a changelog entry for a user-visible change.
